listen_address.description: IP address the collector binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific IP to restrict.

port.description: TCP port on which the collector service accepts incoming HTTP requests.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle incoming requests. Set higher for high throughput.

artifacts_dir.description: Path to the directory where collected test artifacts (logs, reports, binaries) are stored.

max_artifact_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed size (in MiB) for a single artifact. Larger artifacts are rejected.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous open connections allowed.

compress_artifacts.description: Whether to compress artifacts (gzip) before saving them to disk to reduce storage usage.

relays.description: List of trusted upstream debci relays to fetch job definitions and metadata from.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the upstream relay.

port.description: Port number of the upstream relay (typically 80 or 443).

use_tls.description: Whether to use TLS (HTTPS) when connecting to this relay.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' for standard error.

metrics_enabled.description: Whether to expose Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint.

metrics_port.description: Port on which the metrics endpoint is served (if enabled).

health_endpoint.description: HTTP path for the health check endpoint (e.g., used by Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes).
